controls.name: probe_reaches_the_hook
controls.must_fire_because: a probe that cannot show it reached its target has produced no evidence either way (A29)
controls.can_fail_because: a gate copy that is not a hook, or a ROOT rewrite that silently no-opped, returns one verdict for every input and A3 or A1 goes red
controls.null_must_contain: the hook must be capable of BOTH verdicts in the same run, and it gives them: A3 (no switch) is `block` and A1 (fleet-wide STOP) is `exit`
controls.detail: both baseline arms green in the same run, against v9
observations: A3 no stop switch at all: the hook refuses the stop
A1 CONTROL fleet-wide STOP: the hook allows the stop

controls.name: defect_present_at_head_absent_after
controls.must_fire_because: the row claims a defect in a shipped file; one red run proves nothing unless the SAME instrument is green on the repair
controls.can_fail_because: if the pre-fix hook had honoured STOP.<lane>, A2 and B2 would be green at HEAD and the row dies
controls.null_must_contain: the pre-fix run must be capable of passing -- it passes 6 of its 9 arms, including both baselines, so the 3 failures are specific and not a dead probe
controls.detail: v8: 6 pass 3 fail; v9: 9 pass 0 fail -- the three are A2 (own STOP refused), A6 (no such line) and B2 (20 of 20 attempts refused)

controls.name: repair_is_not_a_glob
controls.must_fire_because: H31's own defect restored from the other end would pass the row's headline check and stop all five lanes
controls.can_fail_because: a `STOP*` or `STOP.*` read makes A4 report `exit` and the suite check reports (want block, got exit)
controls.null_must_contain: the cross-lane arm must be capable of `exit` -- the M2 glob mutant makes it exactly that, which is falsifier arm A2
controls.detail: A4 green on the shipped hook, and the glob mutant reddens the suite's cross-lane check while leaving the own-lane check green
observations: A4 another lane's STOP.L2 does not stop L1
a STOP.* glob turns 8b's SECOND check RED — one retirement cannot stop five
and the own-lane check stays green, so A2 is about the glob

controls.name: suite_checks_have_been_red_on_purpose
controls.must_fire_because: §5: a control that cannot fail is not a control, and you state the input that makes it fail
controls.can_fail_because: if any of the three mutants left the suite green, that arm reports FAIL and names which check is inert
controls.null_must_contain: the suite must be capable of passing on the same inputs -- falsifier arm A0 runs it on the shipped hook and it reports its own check count
controls.detail: M1 deleted / M2 globbed / M3 relocated: 3 mutants, 3 distinct checks reddened, 12 of 12 falsifier arms as stated

controls.name: class_sweep_prints_its_hits
controls.must_fire_because: the sweep is the §12.2 half of this row: fix the CLASS, and say what else is in it
controls.can_fail_because: a sweep whose pattern the local grep rejects returns 0 for every name; v1 did exactly that and the count is now computed in python
controls.null_must_contain: the sweep must be capable of a NON-zero -- it reports 1 and prints the line, which is how the hit was identified as a message string
controls.detail: one hit, printed with its text: bringup.sh:618 is `.loop_launcher` inside a MESSAGE STRING, not a read -- so the live count is 0 and the raw count is 1, and both are on the page
observations: -> 1 bare site(s) across 8 per-lane state names.

observations: A2 per-lane STOP.L1 also allows the stop for L1 (want 'exit', got 'block')

falsifiers.fires_when: a turn under STOP.<own lane> ends within the 20-attempt bound

falsifiers.name: F3
falsifiers.can_fail_because: A1 and A2 agree on the pre-fix hook
falsifiers.null_must_contain: both arms read the SAME hook in the SAME run, so agreement is reachable and is what the repaired hook produces

A2 per-lane STOP.L1 also allows the stop for L1 (want 'exit', got 'block')

falsifiers.fires_when: A1 and A2 agree on the pre-fix hook

falsifiers.null_must_contain: the suite has a STOP section (8) that is driven and green, so a per-lane check there would have been found by the same grep that found section 8
